problem.title: Customers message at night. Whoever *replies first* wins them.
problem.lead: It's midnight. A patient with a toothache messages five clinics on WhatsApp and Messenger. How many reply? None.
problem.body: In the morning she's booked with *whichever clinic replied first* — not the best one, the fastest. Customers don't wait around; they message the next business on the list.

msgs.text: Hi, I'd like to book a check-up with Dr. Ahmed tomorrow.. how much is it?
Where exactly is the clinic? Do you accept insurance?
I need to see the doctor urgently, is there an appointment tomorrow?

problem.punch: By morning, all three were patients somewhere else.

villains.title: Answering it yourselves
points: At rush hours, messages pile up and the real work stalls
And at night? Nobody replies — not a failing, just human
Every reply steals minutes nobody has

villains.title: Foreign tools
points: Priced in dollars — you need a credit card or a dollar account
An English dashboard and a complicated setup
Not built for Egyptian Arabic in the first place

solution.title: Same night. Same messages. *The difference? El Radd.*
solution.lead: Your team spends its time on the actual work — El Radd holds every message, night or rush hour.
solution.body: Every message gets a reply in seconds, in natural Egyptian Arabic, using your prices and your rules. *Without touching your phone.*

msgs.text: Hi, I'd like to book a check-up with Dr. Ahmed tomorrow.. how much is it?
msgs.reply: Welcome! The check-up is 350 EGP, and Dr. Ahmed has two slots tomorrow: 11 AM or 6 PM — which works for you?

msgs.text: Where exactly is the clinic? Do you accept insurance?
msgs.reply: We're in Nasr City, in front of the Baron — we do accept insurance. Send us your provider's name and we'll confirm

msgs.text: I need to see the doctor urgently, is there an appointment tomorrow?
msgs.reply: Of course! Send us a message now and we'll book you the earliest available slot

solution.punch: In the morning: three confirmed bookings. While you were asleep.
